Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Having contributed more than 470 pieces of art since 1996’s Mirage set, Kev Walker is Magic’s most prolific artist of all time. Today, his imaginative, evocative, and iconic style is recognized by fans around the globe.

For his Artist Series, Kev picked the cards, created the art, and wrote the flavor text about a hero’s hopeless crusade against the cruelty of the gods. This epic drop even includes the first reprint of Carnage Tyrant ever.

Contents:
• 1x Faeburrow Elder
• 1x Carnage Tyrant
• 1x Fleshbag Marauder
• 1x It That Betrays
